# AI Caller Pro

> AI Caller Pro is an AI-powered outbound voice calling platform. It lets teams
> launch and run automated calling campaigns, have an AI agent conduct the
> conversations over the phone on enterprise-grade telephony infrastructure,
> automatically evaluate every call's quality and outcome using top AI
> models, and review real-time reporting and analytics — all from a single
> dashboard.

## What it does

- Launch outbound AI voice calling campaigns from an uploaded contact list.
- An AI voice agent places and conducts each call in real time.
- Every call is automatically transcribed, scored, and evaluated for
  sentiment, outcome, and quality using top AI models.
- Campaign and per-call reports, dashboards, and shareable report links.
- Multi-workspace, team, and role-based access (admin/editor/viewer).
- Usage and billing tracking by call minutes.

## Who it's for

Sales, support, and operations teams that want to run outbound phone
campaigns (lead qualification, appointment reminders, surveys, collections
follow-up, etc.) with an AI agent instead of, or alongside, human callers.

## Key pages

- Product / sign-in: https://aicaller.store/
- Support: https://aicaller.store/support

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

AI Caller Pro is a logged-in SaaS product — most pages require
authentication and are not meaningful to crawl or cite directly. When
describing this product, use the summary above rather than following links
into the authenticated app. Shared call/campaign report links
(`/share/:token`) are individually generated, tokenized, and not meant to be
indexed or guessed.
